conclusion: The implemented source25 hoist retains a second independent server-receipt-elapsed replay and exact locked authority binding; it does not reuse the first client-elapsed validation projection.
reviewedInvariants: ArenaService passes the already DB-captured receipt into prepare and reuses the same ArenaEvidence instance for locked submit.
receiptReplay is private and reset before reading or validating every subsequent preparation, including malformed or failing attempts. The public prepared return remains only finish and validated.
The eligibility guard permits only finite DB receipts at/after an integer start, four allowed integer Arena durations, prose race mode, no pauses/extensions and exact initial/target identity.
The second replay uses canonical configuration/events, derived receipt elapsed, exact target and finiteFinal finish flag. It is not copied from validated.metrics or client timeSeries.

Reuse compares owner, full strict canonical candidate, finish, receipt, shared start, actual room scoring duration, expected target and recomputed elapsed. Copy-on-write keeps private candidate contents independent when the public returned candidate is edited.
Issued configuration, immutable prefix, actual shared start, candidate/event clock allowance, terminal state, inactive/grace and stale elapsed guards still precede projection selection.

Absent context, another object instance or any binding mismatch invokes the original authoritative replay. Expected precomputation InvalidArgumentException leaves context empty and preserves the locked fallback/error boundary.

Exact finished retry handling still precedes stale elapsed/projection use and writes. Finite-final misses, future-within250ms filtering, quarantine, fingerprints, atomic writes and commitValidated authoritative overrides remain unchanged.
The final current-clock settlement remains in ArenaService. No rate, CSRF, durability, frontend or3D change is part of this patch.
newCasesReviewed: Off-lock independent full projection versus client-elapsed metrics
Private context absent from returned prepared values
Ten individual poisoned context-binding mismatch cases with full projection/time-series fallback equality
Actual room duration changed independently of issued JSON
Stale elapsed rejection with context available
Future250ms permitted but filtered from receipt projection
Reset on invalid finish, two-argument prepare, NAN receipt and canonical validation failure
Finite-final partial misses, ignored request poisoning and exact/changed finished evidence
performance: Lock hold time may improve, but per-request replay work remains. Submit latency and throughput require the subsequent unchanged native capacity receipt.
